name: Connected Component Labeling via Union-Find
definition: Groups same-color pixels into connected components using a Union-Find data structure, where connectivity is defined by a Chebyshev (chessboard) distance search radius.
summary: Connected Component Labeling via Union-Find groups same-color pixels into components using a Union-Find data structure with configurable Chebyshev distance, differing from standard connectivity by allowing adjustable neighborhood ranges.
